hypothesis: The E5 startup-mode split is caused by whether first policy inference samples Manny before or after one fixed skeletal and physics pose-propagation tick.
competing_explanations: PoseSearch chooses a different startup phase independently of policy timing.
Asynchronous Chaos or skeletal initialization is not controlled by delaying policy evaluation.
Tensor-buffer ownership changes packed input after otherwise identical pre-flattening sources.
expected_if_hypothesis_correct: Delay 1 reproduces known Mode B first-input hash 723FD94212B9047A079C11D7ABD572ADCA78DC1C62C87E3CD861D2F9ECEC2CC3 and the provenance trace identifies the earliest changed source.
falsification_observation: Delay 1 does not reproduce Mode B and instead retains Mode A or creates a different first-input state.

exact physics and policy stream hashes
provenance configuration, consumption, source values, and source deltas

implementation.behavior_subject: Add test-only first policy delay gate

excluded_non_authoritative_attempts.reason: The source_commit manifest value shared the correct short prefix but was not an actual full Git object. Both arms were rerun from the same binary with the verified full SHA.
excluded_non_authoritative_attempts.diagnostic_only_observation: The invalid-metadata delay-1 run had the same first delayed positions and rotations as the authoritative delay-1 run but zero body velocities, whereas the authoritative run published nonzero startup velocities. This is not a behavioral verdict.

baseline.configuration: Locked RealOnnxPolicy standing-plant v2 configuration; 1/60 s fixed step; 10 s; unchanged default seed, initial pose, no perturbation, action-semantic trace on, provenance trace on, experimental delay 0.

experimental.configuration: Identical binary, model, protocol, seed, pose, fixed step, capture window, evaluator, action trace, and provenance trace; only experimental delay changed from 0 to 1.

source_localization.summary: The changed pre-flattening source is the live root/body sample. PoseSearch phase, mimic reference frames, future poses, raw terrain heights, and previous actions are identical.

timing_direction_evidence.interpretation: For timing-sensitive pose and terrain terms, delay +1 and historical Mode B lie on opposite sides of Mode A. This is evidence for an earlier-sample hypothesis, not support for the rejected delay-later intervention.

cleanup.retained_diagnostics: The general behavior-neutral first-policy provenance trace from E6 remains.

conclusion.summary: A one-fixed-tick later first inference produced a new input hash, not known Mode B. The first source/action changed, but every active-standing, semantic, physics, policy, render, evaluator-failure, and readback result was identical to baseline. Therefore a later one-tick sample neither reproduces the E5 startup mode nor changes standing behavior.
conclusion.what_was_learned: The earliest timing-sensitive source is the live root/body sample, not PoseSearch phase, mimic reference frames, future poses, raw terrain heights, or previous actions. Historical Mode B's mimic and terrain deltas are almost exact opposites of delay +1, selecting an earlier-sample chronology hypothesis. Startup velocity publication can also vary at the delayed capture boundary, so the next investigation must observe chronology rather than immediately alter behavior.

next_highest_information_experiment.name: Observation-only startup chronology trace
next_highest_information_experiment.hypothesis: Historical Mode B is the live body state from one fixed tick earlier than Mode A, and startup velocity publication timing distinguishes otherwise similar first-input states.
next_highest_information_experiment.single_variable: No behavior variable initially; add only an explicit development trace that samples the existing startup chronology before and after the runtime-state-machine update on each fixed tick through first inference.
next_highest_information_experiment.instrumentation: Capture world time, runtime state before and after TickRuntimeStateMachine, policy accumulator/due state, live root and canonical body position/rotation/linear/angular velocity, PoseSearch identity/time, self ground, and terrain root without running extra inference or changing dispatch.
next_highest_information_experiment.expected_if_correct: One existing earlier chronology sample reconstructs Mode B's self, mimic, and terrain inputs or matches their signed deltas from Mode A, while the current Mode A and +1 samples establish the adjacent timeline.
next_highest_information_experiment.falsifier: No observed earlier startup sample matches Mode B's packed sections or signed deltas; investigation then moves to body-velocity ownership or tensor assembly rather than policy timing.
next_highest_information_experiment.locked_metrics: Exact known first-input hashes, per-section max/RMS and signed correlation, chronology source hashes and deltas, existing active-standing/physics/policy hashes, locked evaluator failure set, and readback ratio; unchanged binary behavior, protocol, and thresholds.
